nodes.title: Warning!
widgets_values:
If the video length is long (e.g. 20s as 481 frames) and the upscale resolution is high (e.g. 2560x1440), the temp files after VAE could be VERY LARGE and your system RAM could be depleted.
Use my H3 latent split Nodes and FFmpeg Video Nodes to split latent into several parts, decode them, convert them to videos and finally concat the video parts.

https://github.com/bbaudio-2025/Comfyui-MiniMax-H3-LatentSplit
https://github.com/bbaudio-2025/ComfyUI-FFmpeg-Video

widgets_values:
Use 8step turbo lora (or even no turbo lora) and more steps to improve quality of upscaled video. (But at cost of longer sampling time).

If you increase denoise level, it should be adjusted carefully. Too much denoise can make result messy and distorted.

Sampler might also affect the video's visuals.

Set proper tile_width and tile _height base on your VRAM. 

If there is defect at seams, try to increase tile_overlap.

If you don't want to split video in spatial, remove (or mute) the node "MMH3 Tiled Diffusion (Experimental)".
